svg.title: The business desk, and the wall behind it
svg.desc: A newspaper business desk with a framed 2014 announcement, a wall of forecasts, a budget board crossed out four times and a model of a station that was never built.

g.text: The business desk, and the wall behind it
Twelve things to find. Three are dated and two of those three disagree.
the budget board, crossed out four times
Dennis - he set the 2014 front page
the graph whose line keeps moving right
the hard hat, with no dust on it
